US To Sell $22 Bln In Reopened 29-Year 11-Month Bonds Thu
WASHINGTON (Dow Jones)--The U.S. Treasury plans to auction $22 billion in reopened 29-year 11-month bonds Thursday.
The debt will settle on Sept. 15, 2026 and will mature Aug. 15, 2056.
The debt is a reopening of an issue first sold on Aug. 17, 2026.The coupon is set at 5.125%.

Noncompetitive tenders for the 29-year 11-month bonds, available in minimum denominations of $100, must be received by 12:00 PM Eastern Time Thursday. Competitive tenders available in minimum denominations of $100, must be received by 1:00 PM Eastern Time.
(Data provided by the U.S. Treasury Dept.)
